source.title: Multi-layered electrode constructs for neural tissue engineering

material: CH–BH multi-layered construct: Pt / PVA–PEDOT CH / PVA–GEL biosynthetic hydrogel with encapsulated astrocytes

formulation.evidence: PVA–Nb and gelatin–Nb were mixed in at 25 : 75 weight ratio to produce a 10% w/t solution
PVA–Nb and gelatin–Nb were mixed in at 25 : 75 weight ratio to produce a 10% w/t solution
Eosin Y was then added to a final concen￾tration of 0.1 mM.
dithiothreitol (DTT, Thermo ScientificTM) in DPBS at a thio-to-norbornene stoichio￾metric ratio of 1 : 2
astrocytes were added to the PVA–GEL macromer solution dissolved in DPBS at a density of 5  106 cells per mL

processing.evidence: photo￾crosslinking via visible light (555 nm) at an intensity of 15 mW cm2 for 3 min
photo￾crosslinking via visible light (555 nm) at an intensity of 15 mW cm2 for 3 min
photo￾crosslinking via visible light (555 nm) at an intensity of 15 mW cm2 for 3 min

conductivity.evidence: the conductivity of both the CH and the CH–BH coating was estimated using eqn (3) and found to be 0.234 S m1 and 0.261 S m1

impedance_1khz.evidence: At 1 kHz, the real part of the impedance was found to be 42.58 O for the CH￾coated electrode, and 38.09 O for the CH–BH-coated one.

description.value: No delamination; non-significant 1.25% decrease in impedance at 1 Hz; max CSC loss 1.38%
description.evidence: Samples were kept at 89 1C for 73 hours, to mimic four months of ageing at 37 1C. No delamination was observed during the incubation period.

duration_days.evidence: The layered assembly was shown to be stable for up to an equivalent of 4 months of ageing.

stability.conditions: accelerated ageing at 89 °C in PBS, equivalent to 4 months at 37 °C

biology.cell_type: primary hippocampal astrocytes (also SCL4.1/F7 Schwann cells for indirect cytotoxicity)

culture_days.evidence: primary astrocytes were then encapsulated in the BH layer and grown for 14 days

other_outcomes.evidence: Astrocytes grown in coated electrodes exhibited a 1.5-fold higher cell density, with around 55 000 cells per cm2 compared to 35 000 cells per cm2 on stand-alone BHs
other_outcomes.name: astrocyte cell density

other_outcomes.evidence: around 1400 mm2 per cell in stand-alone BHs and 1800 mm2 per cell in coated electrodes
other_outcomes.name: cell spreading area

other_outcomes.evidence: an approximate 41% increase in fluorescence from day 3 to day 14 was observed for both CH–BH and BH scaffolds
other_outcomes.name: increase in metabolic activity (Alamar blue) day 3 to day 14

other_outcomes.evidence: a 23.1% increase in density was observed for medium conditioned with CH–BH￾coated electrodes compared to the tissue culture polystyrene (TCP) control
other_outcomes.name: Schwann cell density increase in conditioned medium vs TCP

notes: Electrochemistry in PBS. Conductivity derived from equivalent circuit model.
